name: com.epublys/epublys
title: Epublys
description: EPUB/PDF tools: merge, split, compress, convert, edit metadata, validate ebooks. No key needed for the free tier.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Epublys API key. Without it the free tier runs per IP address; a key from https://epublys.com/account carries your account allowance and Pro.

api_key.description: Optional Epublys API key (starts with epl_). Without it the free tier runs per IP address; a key from https://epublys.com/account carries your account allowance and Pro.
